CHAPTER III
PROTECTION OF WOMEN
Part One
General

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is West Kutai Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Regent as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region of West Kutai Regency.
3. Regent is the Regent of West Kutai.
4. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
5. Woman is a person who has female genitalia, can experience menstruation, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding.
6. Parents are biological father and/or mother, step father and/or mother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
7. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband and wife and their children, or father and children, or mother and children, or blood relatives in direct lineage upward or downward up to the third degree.
8. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
9. Every Person is an individual person or corporation.
10. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
11. Violence Against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life.
12. Protection of Women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, Court, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear, or where violence against women has occurred.
13. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
14. Special Protection of Children is a form of protection received by Children in certain situations and conditions to obtain a guarantee of security against threats that endanger themselves and their lives in their growth and development.
15. Victim is those who suffer physically and mentally as a result of the actions of others who seek fulfillment of their own interests or the interests of others that are contrary to the interests and basic rights of the aggrieved party.
16. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
17. Companion is a social worker who has professional competence in their field.
18. Victim Recovery is all efforts to strengthen victims of domestic violence to be more empowered, both physically and psychologically.
19. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service provider institution for victims established by the Regional Government.
20. Forum for the Protection of Violence Victims hereinafter abbreviated as FPKK is a coordination forum for prevention, handling and empowerment of victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner and established at the Regional, sub-district, and Village/Kampung levels.

Article 18
(1) The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to implement efforts to prevent the occurrence of Violence Against Women and Children, in the form of:
a. collecting data and organizing an information system for the protection of women and Child Victims of violence;
b. conducting education on anti-violence values Against Women and Children; and
c. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to women's empowerment and protection of Child Victims of violence.
(2) The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to provide and organize services for Victims in the form of:
a. establishing and organizing technical service institutions for Victims by involving Community elements; and
b. encouraging Community awareness of the importance of protection for victims of violence.

NUMBER 9 OF 2019
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE


I. GENERAL
Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Economic factors, social environment and technological development have a major influence on the increase of such acts of violence. This condition demands the Regional Government to take concrete steps through activity programs as efforts to prevent and protect women and children from acts of violence.

One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their family.

Efforts to prevent the occurrence of violence against children are the obligation of parents, family, community and the private sector. Community services are the frontline when potential violence against children occurs. The mechanism of violence prevention efforts and protection of child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with family and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Region, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

Article 6
The protection of women as referred to in Article 4 letter a includes:
a. prevention of acts of violence;
b. integrated services for Victims of violence; and
c. empowerment of Victims of violence.

Article 11
Paragraph (1) Letter a What is meant by "complaint services" is a series of actions carried out by integrated service providers to follow up on reports of acts of violence against women and children submitted by victims, families or the community.
Letter b What is meant by "health services" is efforts that include promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative aspects.
Letter c What is meant by "counseling" is a process of providing objective and complete information, carried out systematically with interpersonal communication guidance, guidance techniques and mastery of clinical knowledge that aims to help a person recognize their current condition, the problems being faced, and determine solutions or efforts to overcome these problems.
Letter d What is meant by "spiritual guidance" is a form of activity in which there is a process of spiritual guidance and development for humans so as to provide peace, tranquility and coolness of heart to humans by always providing encouragement and motivation to remain patient, trust in God and continue to carry out their obligations.
Letter e What is meant by "social rehabilitation services" is services aimed at restoring and developing the abilities of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.
Letter f What is meant by "legal aid and assistance services" is legal services provided by legal assistants or advocates to carry out the process of accompanying witnesses and/or victims of violence against women and children that is gender sensitive.
Letter g What is meant by "repatriation and reintegration" is efforts to return women and children victims of violence from abroad to the debarkation point/entry point, or from the receiving area to the area of origin.
Paragraph (2) Letter a Sufficiently clear.
Letter b Sufficiently clear.
Letter c What is meant by "Service Center and Safe House" is what is known as a trauma center, while safe house is known as a shelter.

Article 32
(1) The Regional Government encourages the business sector to participate in the Protection of Women and Children from acts of violence;
(2) Participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may take the form of:
a. socialization to employees within the company environment regarding the dangers of acts of Violence Against Women and Children; and
b. other assistance as a form of corporate social responsibility.

(1) Regional Government conducts cooperation and coordination in order to guarantee the implementation of Protection of Women and Children from acts of Violence.
(2) Cooperation and coordination as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented by Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection through FPKK.

(1) Protection of Children who are Victims of Violence as referred to in Article 4 letter b shall be the responsibility of the Regional Government;

b. providing maintenance, care, and social rehabilitation of neglected Children, both within institutions and outside institutions; and
c. providing shelters, maintenance and care for neglected Children; and

4.4.rationale: The original Indonesian text explicitly includes education as a prevention measure. Pasal 8 ayat (1) huruf c states "memberikan edukasi bahaya Kekerasan dalam rumah tangga" (provide education on the dangers of domestic violence). Pasal 18 ayat (1) huruf b also states "melakukan pendidikan tentang nilai anti Kekerasan Terhadap Perempuan dan Anak" (conduct education on anti-violence values against women and children). These match the English candidate passages the judge cited. Therefore the policy does address prevention through education, making the judge’s Yes correct and suggesting the golden label "No" is wrong.
